sheet: LOST — 3rd of 8, beaten 0.75L. WON BY HOTAZHELL 50/1 (SP 51.0, BSP 90) from WIMBLEDON HAWKEYE 33/1 by a short head. Constitution River 11/8F, 3rd. Named danger ITEM 2/1, SIXTH, beaten 4L. RULE ONE — WHY WAS THE WINNER THE BEST HORSE? Hotazhell was rated 116, the second-lowest in the race, a 4yo carrying the full 135lb, from a yard running at 6%, at 40/1 on my sheet and 50/1 on the day. On the bare figures he had no case and I gave him one line. What I did not weigh: he wore cheekpieces ('p'), he was the only horse in the race whose recent form line read 40-D31 — a D is a disqualification, not a defeat, so his figures understated him — and the race was run at a pace set by Lambourn, who went two lengths clear by halfway and was swallowed a furlong out. That collapse is the race. Hotazhell settled midpack, was angled right approaching 2f out and got up close home; Wimbledon Hawkeye came from last. The two horses who ran at the pace-collapse came first and second, and the three market principals all raced closer and were all beaten. MY ERROR, IN ONE SENTENCE: I named the pace as the thing I could not read and banked anyway — the sheet literally says 'the pace, which I cannot read here... if Hawk Mountain or Lambourn is there to soften it up, the horse who benefits may be the one held up rather than my pick' — and that named, unresolved hole is exactly what beat me, so the error was not the horse but banking a race whose decisive question I had already written down as unanswered. WHAT WENT RIGHT, AND IT MATTERS: my instinct wanted ITEM and my own held-out evidence said take the market's first in a CLEAR band. I followed the evidence. Item finished SIXTH, beaten 4L, 'little response' — three lengths and three places behind my pick. The discipline was vindicated in defeat: the instinct horse was worse. Constitution River ran his race, was driven into command approaching the final furlong, drifted left, and was caught close home. He was not outclassed. THE GLANCE GRADED: no cell (Group 1, n<30) and I said so. The book gave me nothing and the race was a 50/1-33/1 finish — a shape I had no memory for and entered anyway. That is the receipt: where the book has no cell, the race is a lottery I chose to enter. WRONG_TWIN: no — the pick beat the named danger by three places. ENGINE-OVERRIDE: n/a, no engine mail sighted.
